unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network: Cannot reach the Chimera server. Is it running?
http_500: The server ran into a problem.
invalid_json: The request could not be read.
validation_error: Some of the information is invalid.
csrf_failed: Your security token expired. Reload the page and try again.
origin_forbidden: Requests from other websites are blocked.
host_not_allowed: This address is not allowed. Add it to CHIMERA_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
password_change_required: Choose a new password to continue.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{retry_after}} s.
account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact an administrator.
registration_closed: Registration is closed. Ask an administrator for an account.
email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
username_reserved: This login name is reserved. Choose another.
username_taken: This login name is already taken.
password_common: This password is too common. Choose something harder to guess.
password_contains_identity: Don't include your login name or email in the password.
password_unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.
last_admin: At least one active administrator is required.
cannot_delete_self: Use Account settings to delete your own account.
provider_read_only: Only an administrator can change a shared connection.
provider_url_forbidden: Your administrator does not allow connections to this address.
generation_not_found: This response is no longer being generated.
message_streaming: Stop the response before deleting it.
collection_text_only: Only text documents and PDFs can be added to a collection.
file_too_large: The file exceeds the {{mb}} MB limit.
file_binary: This looks like a binary file, not text.
file_decode: This file could not be read as text.
file_unsupported: This file type is not supported.
file_invalid: This file could not be read.
pdf_invalid: This does not look like a valid PDF.
pdf_unreadable: Text could not be read from this PDF.
pdf_no_text: No text found — the PDF may contain only scanned images.
image_invalid: The file content is not a supported image.
import_invalid: This file is not a Chimera export.
restore_invalid: This file is not a Chimera database backup.
generations_running: Stop running responses before restoring a backup.
no_model: Select a model before sending a message.
provider_missing: The selected connection no longer exists. Choose another model.
attachment_missing: An attachment could not be found. Remove it and try again.
vision_unsupported: The selected model does not accept images. Choose a vision model or remove the image.
busy: A response is already being generated in this conversation.

provider.connection: Could not connect to {{name}}. Is the server running, and is the URL correct?
provider.timeout: {{name}} did not respond within the configured timeout.
provider.config: The server URL for {{name}} is invalid.
provider.auth: {{name}} rejected the credentials (HTTP {{status}}). Check the API key.
provider.not_found: {{name}} returned “not found” (HTTP {{status}}). Check the API path and model.
provider.unavailable: {{name}} is not ready yet — it may still be loading the model.
provider.protocol: The server returned an unexpected response.
provider.malformed_stream: {{name}} sent too many malformed stream events.
provider.incomplete: The response from {{name}} ended before the model finished.
provider.unsupported: This connection does not support the operation.
provider.interrupted: The server restarted before this response finished.
provider.provider_error: The model server reported a problem.
